preservation_instructions: Copy selected files and this manifest byte-for-byte under the retained gate-comparison evidence directory. Do not normalize raw logs. Paths in raw logs/scripts are original execution provenance; they are not claims that temporary checkouts are distribution dependencies. The nine omitted files remain untouched outside the repository. No ontology snapshots or reproducible large closure captures are included.
reproduction_note: Baseline/candidate canonical scripts preserve the exact command/environment and capture procedures. Replaying in a different checkout requires selecting new output paths; comparison reports bind the executed bytes and raw diagnostics. Supporting scripts are bounded task evidence, not changes to the repository validation infrastructure.
